blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
blocks.zh: 空间推理仍然是视觉语言模型(VLMs)的长期弱点,因为RGB输入不能直接提供几何证据. 现有的补救办法要么在模型中注入3D,推论中支付建筑和耐久费用,要么进行只监督最后答案的结果奖励培训。 空间误差起源于感知:误判的深度或方向只能通过场景的真实几何来纠正,3D扫描的空间训练来源corpora已经提供. 我们提出GPD(Geometry-Priviled Distillation),使几何证据成为政策上自我沉淀的特权(OPSD). 对于每个问题,深度,语义,和鸟眼视(BEV)的提示作为紧凑的文本提供,并和参考答案一起路由给老师;一个特权的KL,仅适用于不正确的轨迹,增强GRPO,部署的模型仍然只有RGB. 在4B主干线上,GPD在VSI-Bench上实现了57.1,在MindCube,SPARBench,MMSI-Bench和ViewSpatrial上实现了平均37.6,在跨空间推理基准上都优于GPRO和答案偏好OPSD. 缩写证实了3D和回答特权的互补性,问题有条件的路由相对于全文本注射的优势,以及将蒸馏限制在不正确的轨迹的好处.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model (VLM) to judge distance, direction, and layout, as in planning a route, grasping the nearest object, or estimating how far a sofa is from a door. Benchmarks consistently show that these judgments remain difficult for current VLMs ( Yang et al. 2025a ; Wang et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Yang et al. 2025b ; Li et al. 2025a ) . The difficulty stems from the input: RGB frames do not directly provide geometric evidence, so the model must infer depth and layout from appearance alone.
blocks.zh: 空间推理需要一种视觉语言模型(VLM)来判断距离,方向,和布局,例如在规划一个路线,抓住最近的物体,或估计一个沙发离一扇门有多远. 基准一致表明,这些判决对于目前的自愿终止措施来说仍然困难重重(Yang等人,2025a; 王等编. 2025; 张等. 2025; 杨等. 2025b;Li等人,2025a) . 难度出自输入:RGB帧不直接提供几何证据,因此模型必须从外观上单独推断出深度和布局.

blocks.en: Two lines of work address this gap. Explicit 3D methods integrate geometric encoders or representations into the model ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Cheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2026 ; Zheng, Huang, and Wang 2025 ) , or invoke perception and reconstruction tools at test time ( Han et al. 2025 ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Cho et al. 2026 ; Qi et al. 2025 ) , at the cost of architectural changes and additional inference overhead. Training-based methods adapt the model on spatial question-answering data through supervised fine-tuning or outcome-based reinforcement learning ( Ouyang et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025b ; Ma et al. 2025 ) ; RGB-only inference is preserved, but supervision comes only from the final answer, so a geometric error along the reasoning chain, such as a wrong depth order or a flipped left–right relation, is neither localized nor corrected.
blocks.zh: 这两行工作解决了这一差距。 明确的3D方法将几何编码器或表示法整合入模型(Chen等. 2024; 程等编. 2024; 吴等. 2026; 郑. Huang, and Wang 2025 ),或者在测试时间引用感知与重建工具(Han等. 2025; 陈等. 2026; Cho等人著. 2026; Qi等2025),以建筑改造和追加推论间接费用为代价. 基于培训的方法通过有监督的微调或基于结果的强化学习来调整空间问答数据模型(欧阳等. 2025; 李等编. 2025b; Ma等 2025); RGB唯一推论被保留了下来,但监督只来自最后的答案,因此沿着推理链的几何误差,如错误的深度顺序或被翻转的左-右关系,既不是本地化的,也不是被纠正的.

blocks.en:
The two lines thus sit on opposite sides of a trade-off: explicit 3D methods gain geometric evidence but add inference overhead, while training-based methods keep inference RGB-only but train without geometric supervision.
Yet at training time, geometry is readily available: spatial corpora
derived from 3D scans provide depth, semantics, and layout directly,
and off-the-shelf models can estimate the same signals otherwise. These 3D signals cannot serve as inputs at deployment, but they can supervise training as privileged information. The question is how to turn this privilege into supervision that an RGB-only model can internalize.
blocks.zh:
这两行因此坐落在取舍的对面:清晰的3D方法获得几何证据,但增加了推论高架,而以培训为基础的方法只保留了推论RGB,但火车没有几何监督.
然而,在培训时,几何学是现成的:
3D扫描可以直接提供深度、语义和布局
和现成的模型 可以估计相同的信号 否则。 这些3D信号在部署时不能作为投入,但可以监督训练作为特权信息. 问题是如何将这种特权转化为监督,一个只有RGB的模型可以内化.

blocks.en: A natural starting point is on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al. 2026 ; Yang et al. 2026 ) , which converts privilege into supervision: the student samples responses from the task input alone, while the same model, additionally given the privileged context, scores each sampled token as a teacher. In spatial reasoning, however, errors originate in perception: the model misjudges depth, position, or extent, then reasons coherently over the wrong facts. The reference answer, the standard privilege in OPSD, cannot correct such errors: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene’s true geometry . The privilege must instead supply geometric evidence matched to the question: counting, distance, and layout each rest on different evidence.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的起点是政策上的自我消化(OPSD)(赵等. 2026; Yang等 2026),将特权转换为监督:学生单从任务输入中抽取回应,而同一种模式,再加上特权背景,将每个被抽取的令牌评分为教师. 然而,在空间推理中,出错源于感知:模型误判了深度,位置或程度,然后对错误的事实形成一致的理由. 参考答案,OPSD中的标准特权,无法纠正这样的错误:一个被误判的深度或方向只能由场景的真实几何来纠正. 特权必须提供与问题相匹配的几何证据:计数、距离和布局取决于不同的证据。

blocks.en: We introduce GPD , an on-policy self-distillation framework that provides the teacher with question-relevant geometric evidence. For each query, GPD constructs textual cues from depth, semantic segmentation, and bird’s-eye-view (BEV) layouts, and presents the routed cues to the teacher together with the reference answer. The student samples trajectories from RGB observations and the question, while the same VLM, conditioned on the privileged context, re-scores these trajectories token by token. GPD combines this distillation signal with GRPO and applies the privileged KL only to incorrect trajectories, concentrating process supervision on trajectories that require correction. The privilege thus enters only through the training signal, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. Figure illustrates the distinction between GPD and the two prior paradigms.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GPD, 一个政策上的自我消化框架, 它为老师提供了与问题相关的几何证据。 GPD从深度、语义分化、鸟眼观(BEV)布局构建文字提示, 学生从 RGB 观测和问题中取出轨迹样本,而同样的VLM 以特权上下文为条件,以符号重新取出这些轨迹符号. GPD将这种蒸馏信号与GPRO结合,并将特权KL仅适用于不正确的轨迹,将过程监督集中在需要修正的轨迹上. 因此特权只能通过训练信号进入,所部署的型号仍然只有RGB. 图1显示了性别与发展司与前两个范例之间的区别。

blocks.en: We evaluate GPD with Qwen3-VL-Instruct backbones at 2B and 4B scales on five spatial reasoning benchmarks. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench ( Yang et al. 2025a ) and 37.6 average across MindCube ( Wang et al. 2025 ) , SPAR ( Zhang et al. 2025 ) , MMSI ( Yang et al. 2025b ) , and ViewSpatial ( Li et al. 2025a ) , outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD. Ablations confirm the effectiveness of each component. Further analysis indicates that the geometric cues have been internalized by the student model. Together, these results establish question-routed geometric privilege as effective supervision for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们用Qwen3-VL-Instruct主干线在5个空间推理基准上进行2B和4B尺度的GPD评价. 在4B主干线上,GPD在VSI-Bench(杨等2025a)上实现了57.1分,在MindCube(王等2025),SPAR(张等2025),MMSI(杨等2025b)和ViewSpatial(李等2025a)上实现了平均37.6分,均优于GRPO和答案偏好OPSD. 拨款证实了每个组成部分的有效性。 进一步的分析表明,几何提示已被学生模式内化. 这些结果共同确立了有问题路线的几何特权,作为对空间推理的有效监督.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We formulate geometry-aware privileged self-distillation for spatial reasoning, where the teacher is equipped with spatially grounded evidence, enabling meaningful token-level distillation along incorrect reasoning trajectories. • We propose GPD, equipping an OPSD teacher with question-routed depth, semantic, and BEV cues, concentrating token-level distillation on incorrect trajectories while retaining RGB-only inference. • Experiments across two model scales and five benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD, with ablations validating the key design choices.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们为空间推理制定了几何意识的特权自我消化法,使教师具备空间证据,从而能够按照不正确的推理轨迹进行有意义的符号级分馏。 我们提出GPD,为OPSD的老师配备了有问题路由的深度,语义,和BEV提示,将符号级分馏集中在不正确的轨迹上,同时保留了RGB唯一的推论. · 两个模型尺度和五个基准的试验显示,与GRPO和答案优异的OPSD相比,不断改进,同时验证关键设计选择。

blocks.en: We formulate geometry-aware privileged self-distillation for spatial reasoning, where the teacher is equipped with spatially grounded evidence, enabling meaningful token-level distillation along incorrect reasoning trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们为空间推理制定了几何意识的特权自我沉淀法,使教师配备了空间证据,从而能够按照不正确的推理轨迹进行有意义的符号级分馏。

blocks.en: We propose GPD, equipping an OPSD teacher with question-routed depth, semantic, and BEV cues, concentrating token-level distillation on incorrect trajectories while retaining RGB-only inference.
blocks.zh: 我们提出GPD,为OPSD的老师配备了有问题路由的深度,语义,和BEV提示,将符号级分馏集中在不正确的轨迹上,同时保留了RGB唯一的推论.

blocks.en: Experiments across two model scales and five benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD, with ablations validating the key design choices.
blocks.zh: 跨越两个模型尺度和五个基准的实验表明,与GRPO和答案偏好OPSD相比,持续改进,并验证了关键的设计选择。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing work improves spatial reasoning in VLMs through explicit 3D augmentation or training-based adaptation. Explicit methods integrate geometric encoders or representations into VLMs ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Cheng et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2026 ) , or use auxiliary perception, reconstruction, and tool-based pipelines at inference time ( Han et al. 2025 ; Chen et al. 2026 ; Cho et al. 2026 ) . Training-based methods instead apply supervised fine-tuning or outcome-based reinforcement learning to spatial question-answering data ( Ouyang et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025b ; Ma et al. 2025 ) . GPD connects these directions by using 3D cues as teacher-side training privilege, providing geometry-aware token-level supervision while leaving the student architecture and inference inputs unchanged.
blocks.zh: 现有工作通过明确的三维增强或基于培训的适应改进了VLMs的空间推理. 明确的方法将几何编码器或表示器融合到VLM中(Chen等. 2024; 程等编. ; 2024; Wu等 2026),或使用辅助感知,重建,以及推论时间的工具管(Han等. 2025; 陈等. 2026; Cho等 2026 (英语). 以培训为基础的方法则将有监督的微调或基于结果的强化学习应用于空间问答数据(Ouyang等)。 2025; 李等编. 2025b; Ma等人,2025年). GPD通过使用3D提示作为教师-侧式培训特权来连接这些方向,提供几何-知觉符号级的监督,同时让学生架构和推论投入保持不变.

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation transfers information through teacher distributions ( Hinton, Vinyals, and Dean 2015 ) . OPSD extends this idea to on-policy reasoning by conditioning a teacher on privileged information and re-scoring student rollouts token by token ( Zhao et al. 2026 ; Yang et al. 2026 ) . Recent studies examine the stability and refinement of this supervision ( Kim and Lee 2026 ; Shen et al. 2026 ; Kaur et al. 2026 ) , while multimodal variants use privileged crops, zoomed views, or visual-thought traces ( Yuan et al. 2026 ; Cai et al. 2026 ; Li et al. 2026 ) . GPD instead constructs question-routed textual privilege from depth, semantics, and BEV layouts, and applies distillation only to incorrect trajectories.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏通过教师分发(Hinton,Vinyals,和Dean 2015)传递信息. OPSD将这一想法延伸至政策推理,将教师的特权信息作为条件,并将学生推出符号重新评分(赵等. 2026; 杨等. 2026. 最近的研究审查了这种监督的稳定性和完善性(金和李2026;沈等. ; 2026; Kaur等 2026),而多式变种则使用特有作物,放大视图,或视觉思维痕迹(Yuan等. 2026; 蔡等编. 2026; 李等 2026 (中文(简体) ). GPD反而从深度,语义,和BEV布局构造出有问题路由的文字特权,并只对不正确的轨迹应用衍射.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview of GPD
blocks.zh: 3.1 男女平等政策概览

blocks.en: GPD addresses a core tension in spatial reasoning: 3D geometric cues such as depth, layout, and object positions are highly informative for training, yet unavailable at inference when only RGB images and text are observed. Rather than discarding this information or requiring it at test time, GPD uses it as training-time privilege to guide policy learning.
blocks.zh: GPD解决了空间推理中的核心张力:3D几何提示,如深度,布局,和对象位置等,对于训练来说信息性很强,但当只观测到RGB图像和文本时却无法推断. GPD没有放弃这种信息或在测试时要求这种信息,而是将其作为培训时间特权来指导政策学习.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , the method proceeds in two stages. First, for each training sample, GPD constructs compact textual summaries of depth, semantic, and BEV cues offline, then routes only the question-relevant subset to form a privileged context for the teacher. Second, during training, the same VLM plays two roles: as a student conditioned only on RGB and question, it samples on-policy trajectories; as a privileged teacher additionally conditioned on the routed 3D cues and reference answer, it re-scores those trajectories token by token. Training combines outcome-based GRPO ( Shao et al. 2024 ) with privilege-guided distillation applied selectively to incorrect trajectories, leaving the inference interface unchanged.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,该方法分两个阶段进行。 首先,对于每个培训样本,GPD构建了精密的深度、语义和BEV提示的文字摘要下线,然后只引导与问题相关的子集,为教师形成一个特权背景。 其次,在训练期间,同样的VLM扮演两个角色:作为一个仅以RGB和提问为条件的学生,它以政策轨迹为样本;作为一个特权教师,附加以路由3D提示和参考答案为条件,它以象征性方式重新打分这些轨迹符. 培训将基于结果的GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)与特权制导分馏有选择性地应用于不正确的轨迹,使得推论界面保持不变.

Directly applying distillation on all trajectories is suboptimal: when the student already
produces correct responses, the teacher signal may introduce noise or conflicting gradients.

from incorrect trajectories within each optimization micro-batch and clip the

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We compare GPD with general-purpose VLMs ( Hurst et al. 2024 ; Team et al. 2024 ; Li et al. 2024 ; Bai et al. 2025b ) , 3D-augmented methods ( Wu et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ) , and outcome-supervised methods ( Ouyang et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025b ) . For controlled comparison, we train GRPO and OPSD on the same data and backbone ( Shao et al. 2024 ; Zhao et al. 2026 ) . We evaluate on five benchmarks ( Yang et al. 2025a ; Wang et al. 2025 ; Zhang et al. 2025 ; Yang et al. 2025b ; Li et al. 2025a ) : VSI-Bench covers eight video-based spatial reasoning subtasks; MindCube tests mental spatial modeling from limited views; SPAR-Bench evaluates 3D object relations and scene geometry; MMSI-Bench assesses multi-image spatial intelligence; and ViewSpatial-Bench evaluates perspective-dependent spatial understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们把GPD与通用的VLM(Hurst等)进行比较. 2024; Team等. 2024; 李等编. 2024; Bai等2025b),3D强化方法(吴等2026;张等2026),和结果监督方法(欧阳等. 2025; 李等编. 2025b. (中文(简体) ). 为了进行有控制的比较,我们在同一数据和主干线上培训GRPO和OPSD(Shao等人)。 2024; 赵等. 2026. 我们按五个基准(Yang等人,2025a; 王等编. 2025; 张等. 2025; 杨等. 2025b; Li等 2025a):VSI-Bench涵盖8个基于视频的空间推理子任务;MindCube从有限角度测试心理空间模型;SPAR-Bench评价了3D天体关系和场景几何;MMSI-Bench评价了多图像空间智能;而ViewSpatial-Bench评价了依赖视角的空间理解.

blocks.en: We train on 10K VSI, 4K SPAR, and 1K MindCube training-split samples. For VSI and SPAR, which are derived from ScanNet scenes ( Dai et al. 2017 ) , privileged information is generated directly from 3D annotations. For MindCube, which lacks aligned 3D ground truth, we estimate depth with Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al. 2025b ) and obtain semantic instance cues with Grounded-SAM-2 ( Ren et al. 2024b ) . All methods and ablations share the same training mixture and precomputed privileged information.
blocks.zh: 我们用10K VSI,4K SPAR,和1K MindCube 训练的分样。 对于从ScanNet场景衍生出来的VSI和SPAR(Dai等2017年),特权信息直接由3D说明生成. 对于MindCube缺乏对齐的3D地心真伪,我们对深度"Anything 3"(Lin等2025b)进行深度估计,并获得"地心-SAM-2"(Ren等. 2024b (英语). 所有的方法和机床都具有相同的训练混合物和预先计算的特权信息。

blocks.en: All experiments are based on Qwen3-VL-Instruct backbones at 2B and 4B scales ( Bai et al. 2025a ) . We train for one epoch with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , a rollout group size of n = 8 n=8 , and a privileged-distillation weight of λ = 0.003 \lambda=0.003 .
blocks.zh: 所有实验均以2B和4B等尺度的Quen3-VL-指令骨干为基础(Bai等2025a.). 我们训练一个时代,学习率为1×10 − 6 1\times 10×6 },推出组大小为n = 8 n = 8 个;特权-消化重量为Q = 0.003\lambda = 0.003。

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares GPD against general-purpose VLMs, 3D-augmented methods, outcome-supervised methods, and controlled training variants on VSI-Bench. With Qwen3-VL-4B, GPD achieves the highest average accuracy of 57.1 among controlled training variants, improving over the base model by 1.7 points, GRPO by 0.7 points, and OPSD by 1.4 points.
With Qwen3-VL-2B, GPD similarly achieves the best controlled average of 51.7, outperforming the base model and GRPO by 0.4 points and OPSD by 0.9 points.
Across both scales, the improvements on geometry-dependent subtasks align with routed 3D privilege providing depth order and spatial layout cues that are difficult to recover from RGB alone.
blocks.zh:
表1比较了GPD与通用VLM,3D强化方法,结果监督方法,以及VSI-Bench上的受控培训变体. 使用Qune3-VL-4B,GPD在受控训练变体中实现了57.1的最高平均精度,比基准模型提高了1.7分,GRPO提高了0.7分,OPSD提高了1.4分.
有了Qune3-VL-2B,GPD同样实现了最佳控制平均51.7分,比基模型和GPRO的成绩高出0.4分,OPSD则高出0.9分.
在两个尺度上,对几何学依赖子任务的改进与路由3D特权一致,提供深度顺序和空间布局提示,这些提示单从RGB中难以恢复.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports results on MindCube, SPAR-Bench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial. With Qwen3-VL-4B, GPD achieves the highest controlled average of 37.6, improving over GRPO by 1.9 points and OPSD by 6.1 points. GPD obtains the best result among controlled variants on MindCube (38.0 vs. 33.0 for GRPO, +5.0 points), SPAR (43.4 vs. 41.4 for GRPO, +2.0 points), and MMSI (29.4 vs. 28.7 for GRPO, +0.7 points). With Qwen3-VL-2B, GPD again achieves the best controlled average of 33.6, outperforming GRPO by 0.9 points and OPSD by 3.4 points, with the largest gain on MindCube (38.4 vs. 35.8 for GRPO, +2.6 points).
blocks.zh: 表2报告了MindCube、SPAR-Bench、MSI-Bench和ViewSpaceal的情况。 有了Qune3-VL-4B,GPD实现了最高的控制平均37.6分,比GRPO提高了1.9分,OPSD提高了6.1分. GPD在MindCube上(GRPO对33.0分,+5.0分),SPAR(GRPO对43.4分,+2.0分)和MMSI上(GRPO对28.7分,+0.7分)的受控变种中获得最佳结果. 凭借Qune3-VL-2B,GPD再次实现了最佳控制平均值33.6分,比GRPO高0.9分,OPSD高3.4分,在MindCube上收获最多(GRPO38.4对35.8分,+2.6分).

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en:
Figure 3 (left) ablates the privilege design on Qwen3-VL-4B, reporting Avg. as the mean over VSI, MindCube, SPAR, MMSI and ViewSpatial.
Adding the reference answer alone reaches 40.2 (+0.4 points over GRPO), and adding routed 3D text alone reaches 40.5 (+0.7 points). Combining both yields 41.5, confirming that the two sources are complementary: the answer specifies the target outcome while the 3D context supplies geometric evidence. Full 3D text injection (39.8) falls below routed text by 1.7 points despite containing more information, confirming that indiscriminate injection introduces noise. Routed images reach 40.4, below routed text (41.5) by 1.1 points, suggesting that structured text aligns geometric cues with the symbolic reasoning trajectory better than visual overlays.
blocks.zh:
图3(左)放弃了Qwen3-VL-4B上的特权设计,将Avg报告为"VSI",MindCube,SPAR,MMSI和ViewSpatial的平均值.
仅添加参考答案就达到40.2分(比GRPO多出0.4分),仅添加路由3D文本就达到40.5分(+0.7分). 将两者合并为41.5,确认这两个来源是互补的:答案指定了目标结果而3D上下文提供几何证据. 完全3D文字注射(39.8)虽然包含更多信息,但低于路由文字1.7分,证实不分青红皂白地注射会产生噪音. 路由图像以1.1分达到路由文本(41.5)下方的40.4分,表明结构化文本将几何提示与符号推理轨迹比视觉叠加更加一致.

blocks.en: Figure 3 (right) sweeps the privileged KL weight λ \lambda and its application scope with all other components fixed. Applying privileged KL to all trajectories rather than incorrect ones alone reduces Avg. by 0.9 points to 40.6, consistent with noisy teacher signals disturbing already-correct trajectories. Among incorrect-only variants, Avg. rises from 39.6 at λ = 0.001 \lambda=0.001 to 41.5 at λ = 0.003 \lambda=0.003 (+1.7 points over GRPO), then decreases to 40.2 at λ = 0.004 \lambda=0.004 and 39.6 at λ = 0.005 \lambda=0.005 . Too small a weight provides insufficient process-level correction; too large a weight over-constrains the policy and degrades performance.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Privilege injection analysis on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. Left: Zero-shot overall accuracy under different privilege forms on a VSI-590K subset. Right: Normalized routing weight distribution across VSI task categories and 3D modalities.

blocks.en: 4.4 Further Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 进一步分析

blocks.en: Before RL training, we run a controlled zero-shot study on a 1000 1000 -question VSI-590K subset to decide how 3D privilege should be presented. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct using identical RGB observations and, when applicable, the same offline question-conditioned routing over depth, semantic segmentation, and BEV, without providing the reference answer. Figure 4 (left) summarizes the results. All image-based variants and full text injection remain below the RGB-only baseline ( 49.1 49.1 ): full 3D images drop to 47.4 47.4 , while routed images and full text both reach 48.3 48.3 . Routed text is the only variant that exceeds the baseline, reaching 52.2 52.2 ( + 3.1 +3.1 points), motivating its use as the privilege form in GPD.
blocks.zh: 在RL训练之前,我们运行一个可控的零发研究,一个1000-质疑VSI-590K子集,决定如何呈现3D特权. 我们利用相同的RGB观测结果对Qune3-VL-4B-指示进行评估,并在适用时对深度、语义分解和BEV的同线下带问题路由进行评估,但没有提供参考答案。 图4(左)总结了结果。 所有基于图像的变体和全文注入仍然低于仅RGB的基准(49.1 49.1):完整的3D图像降为47.4 47.4,而路由图像和全文则都达到48.3 48.3. 路由文本是唯一超过基线的变体,达到52.2 52.2 (+ 3.1 + 3.1分),激发了它作为GPD中特权形式的使用.

blocks.en: Figure 4 (right) shows the normalized routing distribution across VSI task categories. The pattern aligns well with geometric intuition: object counting is routed entirely to semantic maps, absolute distance relies predominantly on depth, room size is dominated by BEV, and relative direction uses both semantic and BEV. This alignment confirms that the question-conditioned router selects relevant 3D cues rather than injecting every modality.
blocks.zh: 图4 (右)显示VSI任务类别之间正常的路线分布。 图案与几何直觉很吻合:物体计数完全被路由到语义图上,绝对距离主要依靠深度,房间大小由BEV为主,相对方向同时使用语义图和BEV. 这种对接确认,有问题条件的路由器会选择相关的3D提示而不是注入每一种模式.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Comparison of test-time 3D privilege dependence between GRPO and GPD.

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares GPD and GRPO training curves on Qwen3-VL-4B. Both methods show similar validation accuracy in early steps, but GPD gradually pulls ahead and continues to improve while GRPO plateaus. The entropy plot reveals why: GPD reaches a higher entropy peak earlier than GRPO, indicating that privileged KL encourages broader exploration in the early training phase. As entropy levels align in later steps, GPD maintains its accuracy advantage, suggesting that the spatial reasoning modes shaped by privileged supervision are retained.

blocks.en: To test whether GPD internalizes 3D cues during training, we evaluate models trained on Qwen3-VL-4B with and without privilege injection at test time, as shown in Figure 6 . GPD ( 56.3 56.3 ) already outperforms GRPO ( 54.9 54.9 ) under RGB-only inference, and gains less when routed 3D text is injected at test time ( + 0.6 +0.6 vs. + 2.1 +2.1 for GRPO). The smaller privilege gap suggests that GPD internalizes geometric cues during training rather than remaining dependent on them at inference.
blocks.zh: 为了检验GPD在训练期间是否将3D提示内化,我们评价在测试时间使用或不使用特权注射的Qwen3-VL-4B所训练的模型,如图6所示. GPD(56.3 56.3)在RGB唯一推论下已经超过GRPO(54.9 54.9),在测试时间注入路由3D文本时得分较少(+0.6+0.6对+2.1+2.1对GRPO). 较小的特权差距表明,GPD在训练中将几何提示内化,而不是在推断时继续依赖这些提示.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Case study comparing GPD and GRPO on a multi-view spatial question.
blocks.zh: 图7:在多视角空间问题上比较GPD和GPRO的案例研究。

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows a representative case where GPD answers correctly and GRPO fails. GPD correctly localizes the camera, maps the left-forward motion to the spatial frame, and grounds the fountain via cross-view correspondence. GRPO misidentifies the fountain’s position relative to the jar and reaches the wrong conclusion. This illustrates a failure mode of outcome-only supervision, where a geometrically incorrect intermediate judgment goes uncorrected in the absence of process-level geometric guidance.
blocks.zh: 图7显示一个具有代表性的案例,其中GPD回答正确,GPRO失败. GPD将相机正确定位,将左前方运动图映射到空间框上,并通过交叉取景通信来平地喷泉. GRPO将喷泉相对于罐子的位置误认,并得出了错误的结论. 这说明一种只进行结果监督的失败模式,在没有过程级几何指导的情况下,一个几何不正确的中间判断没有被纠正.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present GPD, which augments GRPO with an OPSD teacher conditioned on question-routed depth, semantic, and BEV textual cues together with the reference answer. The teacher applies token-level KL supervision selectively to incorrect student trajectories, enabling the student to internalize geometric reasoning during training while retaining RGB-only inference. Across both model scales and benchmarks, GPD improves overall accuracy over GRPO and outperforms answer-privileged OPSD.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍GPD,它用一个OPSD的教师对GPRO进行扩充,该教师以提问的深度、语义和BEV文字提示以及参考答案为条件。 教师有选择地对不正确的学生轨迹应用符号级KL监督,使学生在训练期间能够将几何推理内化,同时保留了RGB唯一的推论. 从模型尺度和基准来看,性别与发展司的总体准确性都高于全球资源规划,并且超过了回答优先的OPSD。
